# ex: selector match with embedded field accessed through different types
ex {
	var t T1
	t.X -> t.X + 1
}
-- x.go --
package m

type Base struct {
	X int
}

type T1 struct {
	Base
}

type T2 struct {
	Base
}

func F(a T1, b T2) int {
	return a.X + b.X
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -13,5 +13,5 @@
 }

 func F(a T1, b T2) int {
-	return a.X + b.X
+	return a.X + 1 + b.X
 }
